topic: Dashboard UI updates and feature activation
summary_markdown: Discussion covered mockups for metrics and a real-time dashboard design. [p1] explained the addition of 'ACTIVATE' buttons next to disabled blocks, which will trigger an informational popup suggesting users install LiDAR or activate extensions. The purpose is to ensure functionality is visible when presented to clients. Additionally, it was noted that panels related to transport and impressions should be collapsible into a single strip. For Estonia, activation of the transport panel was confirmed.
decisions: Add 'ACTIVATE' buttons next to disabled blocks on the dashboard.
Ensure functionality is visible when presenting the platform to clients.
Collapsible panels for transport and impressions.
action_items: Activate transport panel specifically for Estonia.
